It consists of the "ark:" label followed by a Name Assigning Authority Number, a forward slash, a name, and an optional qualifier (e.g., `ark:12148/btv1b8449691v/f29`).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: resolved
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `to` /SupplyChain/OutOfSpecAction is resolved in the `from` /SupplyChain/ResolutionAction.
A planned location where a good, product, or material is stored.
An inspection action refers to a specific activity or set of activities performed during an inspection to examine, verify, or evaluate an item, process, or system.
Specifies the SSVC decision type.
Authorization specifies the permissions, rights, privileges, or benefits granted to a Role, defining what the role is authorized to access, perform, or receive.
Abstract class representing a License or an OrLaterOperator.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: medium
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The third-highest level of risk posed by an AI system.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: cwe
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [Common Weakness Enumeration](https://csrc.nist.gov/glossary/term/common_weakness_enumeration). A reference to a source of software flaws defined within the official [CWE List](https://cwe.mitre.org/data/) that conforms to the [CWE specification](https://cwe.mitre.org/).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: binaryArtifact
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to binary artifacts related to a package.
Specifies the type of the external reference.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: asilC
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Automotive Safety Integrity Level C under ISO 26262.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: attend
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The vulnerability requires attention from the organization's internal, supervisory-level individuals. Necessary actions include requesting assistance or information about the vulnerability, and may involve publishing a notification either internally and/or externally. CISA recommends remediating Attend vulnerabilities sooner than standard update timelines.

rdf:Description.sh:message: https://spdx.org/rdf/3/terms/Security/VexVulnAssessmentRelationship is an abstract class and should not be instantiated directly. Instantiate a subclass instead.

rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Evaluation is an outcome considering results of a verification.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: assistiveAutomation
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Level 1 - Assistive automation. The system assists an operator.
A type of extension consisting of a list of name value pairs.
The point in time when an element or an action starts, becomes applicable, or becomes valid.
Identifies the full text of a LicenseAddition.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: file
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The file represents a single file (default).
Timestamp, when an assessment was conducted.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: releaseNotes
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to the release notes for a package.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hasConcludedLicense
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Artifact is concluded by the SPDX data creator to be governed by each `to` /SimpleLicensing/AnyLicenseInfo. If the `to` of an Artifact's `hasConcludedLicense` is not the same as the `to` of its `hasDeclaredLicense`, a written explanation should be provided in the comment field of the `hasConcludedLicense` relationship.
Information about the relationship between two Elements.
A LicenseAddition participating in a 'with addition' model.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: cve
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Common Vulnerabilities and Exposures identifiers, an identifier for a specific software flaw defined within the official CVE Dictionary and that conforms to the [CVE specification](https://csrc.nist.gov/glossary/term/cve_id).
Provides information about the completeness of relationships.
A requirementUID is a unique identifier assigned to a Requirement.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: iswc
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [International Standard Musical Work Code (ISWC)](https://www.iswc.org/iswc) is an 11-character unique identifier standardized by [ISO 15707](https://www.iso.org/standard/83125.html) for musical works (compositions) as distinct from specific recordings. While the "ISWC" label and grouping separators (dots and hyphens) are used for human readability, they shall be omitted when the identifier is stored electronically (e.g., `T0017812031`).
A License participating in an 'or later' model.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: deployed
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: In addition to being supported by the supplier, the software is known to have been deployed and is in use. For a software as a service provider, this implies the software is now available as a service.
The valid state for DefinedStateProcess.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: other
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Any specification that does not fall under any of the other entries.
Anonymization methods used.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: follows
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `to` Element succeeds the `from` Element, establishing a unidirectional sequence. This succession is defined as chronological, procedural, or logical. It is used to represent either a temporal order (e.g., in a workflow) or a logical order for processing and traversal (e.g., in an ordered list).
Text specifying the postal code for an address.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: other
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Other exploit catalogs.

rdf:Description.sh:message: https://spdx.org/rdf/3/terms/SupplyChain/CreateAction is an abstract class and should not be instantiated directly. Instantiate a subclass instead.

rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Uniquely identifies an external element.
An Agent responsible for product identification, such as an original equipment manufacturer (OEM).
Specifies the type of the content identifier.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: license
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to additional license information related to an artifact.
The boundary definition is used to define boundaries.
This is the planned individual, business, or organization who currently manages goods, services, or assets.
Impact justification label to be used when linking a vulnerability to an element representing a VEX product with a VexNotAffectedVulnAssessmentRelationship relationship.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: expandsTo
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element expands out as an artifact described by each `to` Element.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: securityAdvisory
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to a published security advisory (where advisory is defined per [ISO 29147:2018](https://www.iso.org/standard/72311.html)) that may affect one or more elements, e.g., vendor advisories or specific NVD entries.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: reportedBy
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Designates a `from` /Security/Vulnerability was first reported to a project, vendor, or tracking database for formal identification by each `to` Agent.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: audit
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: An examination typically focusing on compliance with policies, standards, or regulations. Usually this is done during an audit meeting, while the assessment also involves deep and detailed reviews of work products (e.g. requirements, verification specifications, reports etc.)

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: function
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Simulation the function of the hardware.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: timestamp
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Data is recorded with a timestamp for each entry, but not necessarily ordered or at specific intervals, such as when a taxi ride starts and ends.
Specifies the type of simulation model used to represent virtual hardware.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: limitedSupport
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The artifact has been released, and there is limited support available from the supplier. There is a validUntilDate that can provide additional information about the duration of support.
This individual element was defined by the spec.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: other
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Any other relevant type of proof or documentation not covered above.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: graph
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Data is in the form of a graph where entries are somehow related to each other through edges, such as a social network of friends.
Enumeration of the different kinds of SPDX file.
Identifies a functional safety integrity level associated with a relationship.
Country for which export controls must be taken into account.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: testedOn
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element has been tested on the `to` Element(s).
The length along the x-axis.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: operations
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The element follows the Operations profile specification.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: other
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Used when the type does not match any of the other options.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: swhid
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: SoftWare Hash IDentifier, a persistent intrinsic identifier for digital artifacts, such as files, trees (also known as directories or folders), commits, and other objects typically found in version control systems. The format of the identifiers is defined in the [SWHID specification](https://www.swhid.org/swhid-specification/v1.2/) ([ISO/IEC 18670](https://www.iso.org/standard/89985.html)). They typically look like `swh:1:cnt:94a9ed024d3859793618152ea559a168bbcbb5e2`.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: buildSystem
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to the build system used to create or publish the package.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: sha384
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: SHA-2 with a digest length of 384, as defined in [RFC 6234](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/rfc6234/).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: adler32
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Adler-32 checksum is part of the widely used zlib compression library as defined in [RFC 1950](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/rfc1950/) Section 2.3.
A software agent.
Describes if a given file is a directory or non-directory kind of file.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hasResolution
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` /SupplyChain/ResolutionAction points to the `to` /SupplyChain/OutOfSpecAction that is addressed.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: recording
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Captured datastream like audio, video, or any other kind of continuous electronic capture of events, behavior or conditions.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: vulnerabilityExploitabilityAssessment
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to a Vulnerability Exploitability eXchange (VEX) statement which provides information on whether a product is impacted by a specific vulnerability in an included package and, if affected, whether there are actions recommended to remediate. See also [NTIA VEX one-page summary](https://ntia.gov/files/ntia/publications/vex_one-page_summary.pdf).
Specifies the algorithm used for calculating the hash value.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: asilB
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Automotive Safety Integrity Level B under ISO 26262.
Abstract class representing a license combination consisting of one or more licenses.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: crl
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Certificate Revocation List, or CRL, is a list of revoked certificates that is downloaded from the Certificate Authority (CA).
Energy consumed when training the AI model that is being used in the AI system.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: expandedLicensing
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The element follows the ExpandedLicensing profile specification.
AssemblyAction represents the event of creating a product by assembling individual components.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: qm
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Quality management level.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: doi
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [Digital Object Identifier (DOI)](https://www.doi.org/the-identifier/what-is-a-doi/) is a unique, [ISO 26324](https://www.iso.org/standard/88862.html)-standardized identifier for physical, digital, or abstract objects, formatted as a prefix and suffix separated by a forward slash (e.g., `10.1000/182`).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: other
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Other.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: active
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: In use.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: verificationUID
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The unique identifier used by a verification management system or any other lifecycle management tool to uniquely identify a verification item.
Products out of specification require a resolution action. This is the action of resolution.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: query
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Dataset is publicly available, but not all at once, and can only be accessed through queries which return parts of the dataset.
Provides a numerical (0-10) representation of the severity of a vulnerability.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: rorid
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [Research Organization Registry (ROR) identifier](https://ror.org/about/) is a unique identifier for research and funding organization, typically expressed in its preferred URI form such as `https://ror.org/02mhbdp94`.
Specified the time and date when a vulnerability was withdrawn.
Provides the location of an exploit catalog.
The name of the recipient expressed in text.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: clickthrough
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Dataset is not publicly available and can only be accessed after affirmatively accepting terms on a clickthrough webpage.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: swhid
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: SoftWare Hash IDentifier, a persistent intrinsic identifier for digital artifacts, such as files, trees (also known as directories or folders), commits, and other objects typically found in version control systems. The format of the identifiers is defined in the [SWHID specification](https://www.swhid.org/swhid-specification/v1.2/) ([ISO/IEC 18670](https://www.iso.org/standard/89985.html)). They typically look like `swh:1:cnt:94a9ed024d3859793618152ea559a168bbcbb5e2`.

https://spdx.org/rdf/3/terms/SupplyChain/UseProcess is an abstract class and should not be instantiated directly. Instantiate a subclass instead.

rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Identifies the download Uniform Resource Identifier for the package at the time that the document was created.
HarvestAction represents the act of creating a product by directly extracting goods or materials from nature.
Provides information about the content type of an Element or a property.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: npm
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to an npm package. The package locator format is defined in the [npm documentation](https://docs.npmjs.com/cli/v10/configuring-npm/package-json) and looks like `package@version`.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: glue
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [GLobal Unique Enterprise (GLUE) Identifiers](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/draft-ietf-spice-glue-id/), as defined by the IETF Internet-Draft, is expressed as a GLUE URI, a Uniform Resource Identifier that standardizes the representation of existing organizational entity identifiers.
How the dataset was collected.

rdf:Description.sh:message: https://spdx.org/rdf/3/terms/SupplyChain/ModifyProcess is an abstract class and should not be instantiated directly. Instantiate a subclass instead.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: iscc
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [International Standard Content Code (ISCC)](https://iscc.io/) is a content-derived identifier standardized by [ISO 24138](https://www.iso.org/standard/77899.html) for identifying digital assets. ISCC can be used in conjunction with other schemes, such as DOI, ISAN, ISBN, ISRC, ISSN and ISWC. A standard ISCC-CODE is build from multiple ISCC-UNITs. Each unit serve a different purpose. An ISCC-CODE typically look like `ISCC:KACT4EBWK27737D2AYCJRAL5Z36G76RFRMO4554RU26HZ4ORJGIVHDI`.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: releaseHistory
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to a published list of releases for a package.
The amount or measure of a bulk product.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: evidence
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The Element is the evidence that a specification or requirement has been fulfilled.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: test
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A relationship has specific context implications during an element's testing phase, during development.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: timeseries
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Data is recorded in an ordered sequence of timestamped entries, such as the price of a stock over the course of a day.

**DEPRECATED in SPDX 3.1.** Use [/Core/endTime](../../Core/Properties/endTime.md) instead.
Property that describes the time at which a build stops.
Class that describes an InstantiateVirtualHardwareProcess that is used to define VirtualHardware and its source.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: review
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A examination or checking of documentation, records, processes, or systems to confirm compliance or adherence with an upper level requirement. Typically done as peer review, offline review or review meeting.
An entity that is authorized to issue identification credentials.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: green
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Community wide. The dataset shall be shared only within a community of peers and partners.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: blake2b384
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: BLAKE2b algorithm with a digest size of 384, as defined in [RFC 7693](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/rfc7693/) Section 4.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: design
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A relationship has specific context implications during an element's design.

referenceSpecification provides a reference to a DefinedType that defines the specific meaning, structure, and semantics of a Role. It connects the role to its authoritative source definition, ensuring consistent interpretation across different contexts.
The percentile of the current probability score.
The physical mass of a hardware component.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: isan
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [International Standard Audiovisual Number (ISAN)](https://www.isan.org/about/#what_is_isan) is a unique 24-digit hexadecimal identifier for audiovisual works standardized by [ISO 15706](https://www.iso.org/standard/83124.html). The ISAN remains persistent for a work regardless of its distribution format or its use. To facilitate human readability, the "ISAN" label, grouping hyphens, and two check characters are included (e.g., `ISAN 0000-0000-3A8D-0000-Z-0000-0000-6`); however, these elements shall be omitted when the identifier is stored electronically (e.g., `000000003A8D000000000000`).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: directory
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The file represents a directory and all content stored in that directory.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: pretrainedOn
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element has been pretrained on the `to` Element(s).
Title of the project.
Information about different steps of the training process.
Property that describes the URI of the build configuration source file.

rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A QUDT (Quantity, Unit, Dimension and Type) unit applied to measurement criteria based on product type, region, and use.
Unit of energy consumption.
Harvest is the process of extracting goods or products from nature.
roleQualification specifies the requirements, criteria, or conditions that must be met for an entity to be considered qualified to fulfill a particular role.
A specification type defines the nature of a specification.
Provides an unambiguous mechanism for conveying a URI fragment portion of an Element ID.
Date of product release.
The type of external reference.
A PlanAction involves the execution of a plan in relation to a PlanProcess.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: data
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The Element is data.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: source
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: SBOM created directly from the development environment, source files, and included dependencies used to build a product artifact.
Identifies the nature of the contactPointRelationship.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: file
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The Element is a single file which can be independently distributed (configuration file, statically linked binary, Kubernetes deployment, etc.).
Refers to any object that stores content on a computer.
Portion of an AnyLicenseInfo representing a set of licensing information where all elements apply.
An Individual Value for Element representing a set of Elements of unknown identity or cardinality (number).
Threshold that was used for computation of a metric described in the metric field.
Enumeration of dataset types.
Identifies the full text of a LicenseAddition, in SPDX templating format.
Specifies an Element as subject of an assessment.
Street address includes a street number, name and unit ID to identify a specific street.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: publishedBy
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Designates a `from` /Security/Vulnerability was made available for public use or reference by each `to` Agent.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: ownership
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Ownership refers to the legal right to control, manage, and benefit from an asset, resource, or responsibility. It establishes authority, accountability, and entitlements over something, whether it's property, a business, intellectual property, or responsibilities.
A reference to a resource identifier defined outside the scope of SPDX 3 content that uniquely identifies an Element.
A buildId is a locally unique identifier used by a builder to identify a unique instance of a build produced by it.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: ocsp
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Online Certificate Status Protocol, or OCSP, is a common scheme used to maintain the security of a server and other network resources.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: complete
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The relationship is known to be exhaustive.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hasAddedFile
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Every `to` Element is a file added to the `from` Element (`from` hasAddedFile `to`).
Timestamp of impact statement.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hasStaticLink
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element statically links in each `to` Element, during a LifecycleScopeType period.
A collection of SPDX Elements that could potentially be serialized.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: draft
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Not yet finalized; under development or review.

rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Identifies the full text of a License, in SPDX templating format.
Categories of presence or absence.
Identifies the tooling that was used during the creation of the Element.

rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` /Security/Vulnerability has no impact on each `to` Element. The use of the `doesNotAffect` is constrained to `/Security/VexNotAffectedVulnAssessmentRelationship` classed relationships.
Quantity is the amount in the selected QUDT unit.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: securityPolicy
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to instructions for reporting newly discovered security vulnerabilities for a package.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: fixedIn
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A `from` /Security/Vulnerability has been fixed in each `to` Element. The use of the `fixedIn` type is constrained to `/Security/VexFixedVulnAssessmentRelationship` classed relationships.
Specifies the CVSS qualitative severity rating of a vulnerability in relation to a piece of software.
Type of support that is associated with an artifact.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: validatedOn

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: other
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Any other units of energy measurement.

rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to a purchase order for a package.
A prescribed change to a product.

The length along the z-axis.

rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: SHA-2 with a digest length of 256, as defined in [RFC 6234](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/rfc6234/).
